text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Animals and Birds (Exemption) Notification.

2. The Director-General hereby exempts from section 8 of the Act any person who imports any fresh table hen egg —
(a)from any of the countries specified in the first column of the Schedule; and
(b)subject to the corresponding maximum amount specified in the second column of the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Countries from which fresh table hen eggs may be imported
First column
Second column
Countries from which eggs may be imported
Maximum amount of eggs which may be imported
Australia, France and New Zealand
30 eggs per person.
